title: Cloud sessions run the full ritmofit-web gate, and a saved cloud environment sets them up
acceptance: In a claude.ai/code cloud session on this repo, every command in AGENTS.md › Verification, PRs, And Commits passes from a fresh clone, including pnpm --filter @ritmofit/e2e e2e, with wall times recorded here.

A personal cloud environment for this repo holds a setup script made only of commands that session ran (install, .dev.vars from the example, local D1 migrate and seed, any Playwright step), and its name is recorded here; no secret is stored in it.
nextAction: For review until one check is seen: a brand-new cloud session on the 'ritmofit-web' environment, where the setup script and the saved E2E_EXECUTABLE_PATH apply at start, passes pnpm --filter @ritmofit/e2e e2e with no inline variable. The first web batch #801 builder's gate is that check; record it here and set Done (in #801's close-out PR or the next records PR). So far: every other AGENTS.md gate command passed from a fresh clone in the cloud (213 s), and e2e passed 4/4 in 42 s on #803's 32a1a19 with the variable set inline; the environment holds the setup script and the variable, no secrets.

evidence.summary: Cloud run, 2026-11-25 (MST), started by the owner from the desktop app on main; the session's report was pasted to the Neo conductor by the owner. Fresh shallow clone, 4 CPUs, 15 GB RAM, no network host blocked, setup about 26 s. Every AGENTS.md › Verification command except e2e passed, with wall times: format:check 9 s, owner-gate:test 4 s, rf-trace:test 0 s, release-status:test 2 s, tasks:test 1 s, tasks:check 1 s, -r typecheck 19 s, lint 9 s, design-system verify 0 s, theme-classes --selftest 1 s, theme-classes 1 s, pnpm test 77 s, api test:integration 71 s, web build 16 s, openapi 0 s, git diff --exit-code openapi.json 1 s, contract-parity 0 s, audit:ci 1 s; 213 s for those, 231 s with the e2e attempt. e2e failed in 18 s with 'browserType.launch: Executable doesn't exist at /opt/pw-browsers/chromium_headless_shell-1248/...' (the repo's Playwright 1.64.1 wants browser build 1248; the image has 1243). With an uncommitted executablePath '/opt/pw-browsers/chromium' override, e2e passed 4/4 in 36 s (about 250 s total), then the override was deleted. Nothing committed from the cloud session; no wrangler login, deploy or remote D1.

Cloud environment created by that session: personal 'ritmofit-web' (env_014XnKGjb4btEGGDW9GvEixN), repository steven-crosby/ritmofit-web, no extra hosts, no variables, no secrets. Setup script, guarded on the ritmofit-web folder existing and made only of commands the session ran and saw succeed from the parent directory: git fetch --unshallow (only when shallow), corepack enable, pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, copy apps/api/.dev.vars from the example when missing, db:migrate:local and db:seed:local; a second run succeeded in 4 s. Acceptance line 2 is met; line 1 waits on the e2e fix on this branch.
Draft PR from the Neo conductor: e2e/playwright.config.ts reads E2E_EXECUTABLE_PATH (README notes it) plus this record; opened 2026-11-25, not merged.

Cloud rerun, 2026-11-25 (MST), in the owner's RF-251 cloud session on head 32a1a1928ff8eaba71726f153e14b220c4d639bd with the repo's own e2e/playwright.config.ts and no override: pnpm --filter @ritmofit/e2e e2e passed 4/4 (desktop-1440 and phone-390) in 42 s (Playwright 39.7 s), with E2E_EXECUTABLE_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers/chromium set inline. The session saved that variable on the 'ritmofit-web' environment (it applies from the next session start); setup was not re-run because the branch changes nothing in apps/, packages/, the lockfile or migrations. Not yet seen: a brand-new session where the setup script and the saved variable apply at start; the first batch #801 builder is that check. Report pasted to the Neo conductor by the owner; nothing committed from the cloud session.
